snippet.title: [SM64 Hack] Serene Fusion Release
snippet.description:
Gameplay from Fangame Marathon 2022: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8kH5pVxqKn4

Serene Fusion is a SM64 romhack that was made to remediate Project 74 courses. Not only it features the best courses from the Super Mario 74 remade but also includes a whole lot of side content made by various romhackers!

Made by aglab2, ArthurTilly, axollyon, BroDute, Dan_GPTV, DNVIC, LinCrash, Luigiman04, Mushie64, Reonu, Rovert, scuttlebug_raiser, sm64pie, thecozies, TheGael95, UsernamesAreSpiders and ZenonX.

Download:
Z64: https://romhacking.com/hack/Serene-Fusion
VC (not recommended - random crashes & axollyon course issues): https://mega.nz/file/2C4xVTJB#bgHxwi8UVaiDDxMZvEq6XMVSRTpiFu3mMFxdZhNkhsQ

Supported platforms:
1) Parallel Launcher with OGRE graphics plugin.
2) Project 64 with GLideN64/LINK's GLideN64 4.2/ANGLE GLideN64. How to install good plugins on Project 64 1.6: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC2DXhO-sAI

For Project64 2.4: Options - Settings, click on the + next to Config: ProjectSF, click Recompiler and disable register caching. Thanks ShiN3 for figuring that out!

Please do not use bad graphics plugin like Jabo as it may trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Thank you!
